pullRequests.body:
The first reward previously led into a roughly 30-second claim gap. This layer changes the accepted claim cadence to 18 seconds, anchored after the existing 10-second first claim, and adds deterministic rules for a default-off, local Sample adventure.

The Sample includes eight encounter types, five three-phase bosses with counters and recovery Pounce, Ember/Moss/Star set builds, item affixes, protected loadouts, directed crafting and visible pity, mastery, optional reversible tours, collections, persistent goals, capped return rewards, and optional challenge/assist rules. UI and original art follow in separate stacked drafts.

Validation: full #275–#282 baseline passed 399 E2E and 1,482 web units; this layer's game-rules suite passes 482 tests, retaining 11 pre-existing skips and two expected failures. Five-seed model checks give natural min-max chapter-two fights of 25–31 seconds; idle starter clears chapter one. Economy tests retain authoritative grants and deterministic replay, including repeated requests and local-only play. Exact numeric changes: docs/decisions/gameplay-2026-11-05.md. Baseline and research receipts: reports/gameplay2/.

Safety: features.cafeAdventure=false; explicit guest opt-in only. Sample inventory, patches, mastery and tours cannot award Fish, Yarn, Keys or Relics. No Supabase, contract, DB, migration, signing or funds changes. Vercel deployment is disabled for all candidate branches in both config files.

Candidate build, not live. **Not merged, not deployed.** Stack order: #275 → #276 → #277 → #278 → #279 → #280 → #281 → #282 → this rules layer → art → UI → proof/demo. Never merge a tip directly. The offline demo and integrated performance/screenshots/fresh-eyes scores will be in the final proof draft; this is not a release approval.

The guest candidate now has a playable local adventure: choose routes through eight encounters, read five three-phase bosses, counter and Pounce, assemble Ember/Moss/Star sets, compare affixes, save two kits, and craft with disclosed odds and item-bound pity. The journal, persistent goals, mastery, optional undoable tours, capped away summary, challenge tiers and explicit assist give the next visit a purpose.

The approved left navigation and top HUD remain. New controls support keyboard input, text/shape cues, reduced motion and hidden-tab pause. Fresh review fixed an overstated near-cap Spark gain, a next-room action below the 720px viewport, and a recovery cue that promised bonus damage without a matched counter. Affixes now explain their effect and room scaling.

![Boss counterplay](https://github.com/ntbaoheyhey/taskbar-hero/blob/ai/codex-ui-ledger/reports/gameplay2/screens/boss-1280.png?raw=true)
![Workshop](https://github.com/ntbaoheyhey/taskbar-hero/blob/ai/codex-ui-ledger/reports/gameplay2/screens/workshop-1280.png?raw=true)

Final integrated proof #286 adds the stable-arena regression and passes 413/413 locally and in hosted CI. The final Sample audit covers 30 views across 1280×720, 1440×900 and 1920×1080, with 198 keyboard samples and zero axe violations, overflow, offscreen focus, page errors or writes. Three normal-clock Sample walks have maximum opportunity gaps of 11.27s / 15.82s / 15.95s. Retrospective self-score 8.34→8.56, below 9+; scripted evidence is not human retention research. [Full report](https://github.com/ntbaoheyhey/taskbar-hero/blob/ai/codex-ui-ledger/reports/gameplay2/GAMEPLAY-2-REPORT.md).

Run `pnpm demo`, then `http://127.0.0.1:5391/?demo&coach=off&adventure=1#home`. Add `&adventureDebug=1` only in development for review controls. The self-contained offline demo follows in the proof draft.

Real OS tab visibility remains unverified; synthetic pause and reduced-motion checks pass. No backend, contracts, DB, signing or funds changes.

The new adventure can now be reviewed by double-clicking `docs/gameplay2/index.html`: actual Sample UI/rules, embedded original art/fonts, three-seed before/after timelines, a three-build comparison, numeric decisions and provenance. No server or network is needed. `docs/gameplay2/README.md` gives a five-minute review and real-build guest/debug entries.

This layer also fixes unattended route/reward geometry that moved the arena, with an exact-bound browser regression. It adds reproducible audit, balance, timing and offline-demo tools. Final runtime: `629aa8b`; proof head: `0b92553`.

![Boss counterplay](https://github.com/ntbaoheyhey/taskbar-hero/blob/ai/codex-ui-ledger/reports/gameplay2/screens/boss-1280.png?raw=true)
![Workshop](https://github.com/ntbaoheyhey/taskbar-hero/blob/ai/codex-ui-ledger/reports/gameplay2/screens/workshop-1280.png?raw=true)

Measured evidence:
- Three normal-clock main-game walks: maximum actual reward gap 30.01–30.20s → 18.01–18.03s. Sample opportunity gaps 11.27–15.95s. These are separate metrics, not human decision counts.
- Five seeds × three styles × 20 model minutes; Sample idle clears room one 5/5, natural min-max room-two fights take 25–31s. Main boss path is unchanged and its idle first attempt still loses.
- Integrated local E2E **413/413**, web units **1498**, game-rules **482** plus unchanged 11 inherited skips/two expected failures; typecheck, lint, build, art and economy/replay checks pass. All four exact draft heads have green hosted CI. Proof `0b92553` passed [run 41949368025](https://github.com/ntbaoheyhey/taskbar-hero/actions/runs/41949368025): 6/6 native preflight, 413/413 full E2E, 1498 web units and all node checks.
- 30 Sample views across 1280×720, 1440×900 and 1920×1080: zero axe, overflow, offscreen keyboard targets, page errors or writes; 198 keyboard samples. Offline file demo passes all three sizes with zero external requests.
- Added **23,964 bytes gzip JS**, **3,268 runtime image bytes**. Production p95 ≤16.8ms, renderer task 0.60–1.16%, global CLS ≤0.000154. Synthetic hidden pause and reduced motion pass; real OS visibility remains unverified.

Self-grading: early Sample → corrected Sample **8.34 → 8.56**, four equally weighted fun/clarity/depth/polish axes. **9+ not reached.** Prior pass's 8.7 was a different visual rubric. `FRESH-EYES.md` explicitly documents retrospective scoring, rapid fixture sequences and the lack of independent/human retention evidence. Strict main first-reward wall time remains 10.049–10.075s, just over the 10s target.

[Full report](https://github.com/ntbaoheyhey/taskbar-hero/blob/ai/codex-ui-ledger/reports/gameplay2/GAMEPLAY-2-REPORT.md) and [raw receipts / SHA-bound CI](https://github.com/ntbaoheyhey/taskbar-hero/tree/ai/codex-ui-ledger/reports/gameplay2). Compact measurements are also on this branch.

Risk/flags: `features.cafeAdventure=false`; explicit guest opt-in only. Sample inventory, patches, mastery and tours never grant server currency, Cat Keys or Relics. Verified replay and market rules remain unchanged. No Supabase, contracts, DB, migration, signing or funds changes. Vercel Git deployment is disabled at both configuration roots.

Candidate build, not live. **Not merged, not deployed.** Merge order: #275 → #276 → #277 → #278 → #279 → #280 → #281 → #282 → #283 → #284 → #285 → this proof/demo layer. Never merge a tip directly. Later retarget/merge/release needs a fresh full-stack check.
